segments.en: Through charity one merits to grace.
Through humility one merits to grace.
To find grace, one should be a host to guests.

segments.he:
ד.

גַּם יִשְׁמֹר אֶת עַצְמוֹ מִמַּאַכְלֵי אִסּוּר, וְיִשְׁמֹר אֶת פִּיו מִדִּבּוּר אָסוּר.
segments.en: Also, one should guard oneself from forbidden foods, and guard one's mouth from forbidden speech.

segments.he:
ה.

מִי שֶׁמְּפַזֵּר מְעוֹתָיו בִּשְׁבִיל לִקְנוֹת לְעַצְמוֹ רַב לִלְמֹד מִמֶּנּוּ, עַל-יְדֵי-זֶה יִמְצָא חֵן.
segments.en: One who expends money to acquire a rabbi from whom to learn, through this he will find grace.

segments.he:
ו.

כְּשֶׁתַּעֲבִיר עַל מִדּוֹתֶיךָ, תִּמְצָא חֵן.
segments.en: When you defer, you will find grace.
Through [giving] rebuke, you will find grace.
Olive oil is a segulah (auspicious) for grace.

segments.he:
ט.

סְגֻלָּה לְחֵן תִּכְתֹּב עַל קְלַף, כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת אַלּוּף.
segments.en: A segulah for finding grace is to write on parchment, "Silver and gold kindness and truth champion."

segments.he:
י.



עַל-יְדֵי הַיִּרְאָה מִתַּלְמִיד-חָכָם תִּזְכֶּה לְחֵן.
segments.en: By the awe [you have] for a Torah scholar, you merit to grace.

segments.he:
יא.

דִּבּוּרִים הַיּוֹצְאִים בְּנִיחוּתָא נִתְקַבְּלִים אֵצֶל בְּנֵי-אָדָם.
segments.en: Words that are spoken (lit. come out) calmly are accepted by people.

segments.he:
יב.

יֵשׁ דָּגִים שֶׁהֵם מְסֻגָּלִים לְחֵן.
segments.en: There are fish which are conducive to grace.

segments.he:
יג.

עֵסֶק הַתּוֹרָה בַּדֶּרֶךְ נוֹתֶנֶת חֵן.
segments.en: Learning Torah while traveling gives one grace.

segments.he:
א.

כְּשֶׁאָדָם בָּא לְעִיר לָדוּר, יִשְׁלַח בָּשָׂר לַעֲנִיֵּי הָעִיר, וְעַל-יְדֵי-זֶה יִשָּׂא חֵן בְּעֵינֵי שָׂרֵי הָעִיר.
segments.en: When a man comes to a city to live, he should send meat to the poor of the city, and through this he will find grace in the eyes of the city's officials.
